card.name: Words just before vaccine terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas and word parts that come right before the word vaccine, vaccines or vaccination. Seen in immunization instructions and in lists of vaccine types.

modes.label: Before vaccination instructions
modes.description: The word "appropriate" in "age-appropriate" ahead of immunizations or vaccinations.
modes.example: administer all age-app<<ropriate>> immunizations according to immunization guidelines at

modes.label: Inside vaccine lists
modes.description: Commas or word parts in a list of vaccine types, where another vaccine name comes next.
modes.example: pneumococcal conjugate vaccines<<,>> and seasonal inactivated influenza vaccines.

modes.label: Up-to-date phrasing
modes.description: Words like "with" or "both" after "up to date", where vaccines come next.
modes.example: not up to date<< with>> vaccines against encapsulated bacteria

card.writes: It makes the model more likely to write vaccine, vaccination or immunization words next, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a vaccine term is expected.
